title: Al'arshin Gaskiya
intro: Wani mai iko mai iko, wanda aka san shi da hikimarsa mai girma da kuma gadon sarauta mai girma, ya sami wani saƙo mai ban mamaki daga wani tushe da ba a sani ba. Wannan sadarwa ta bazata tana ƙalubalantar imaninsu da ikonsu, tana sanya su a cikin tafiya ta diflomasiyya wadda za ta gwada hankalinsu kuma a ƙarshe ta kai ga farkawa ta ruhaniya mai zurfi. Za ku iya gano asalin wannan mai iko da abubuwan da suka canza masarautarsu gaba ɗaya?
clues: Ni da mutanena muna bauta wa rana, muna bin hanyoyin kakanninmu.
Tsuntsu, mai kama da ƙugu, shine manzon da ba a zata ba wanda ya kawo min wasiƙa daga shugaba mai iko.
Domin in gwada hikimar mai aikawa, na aika da kyaututtuka masu daraja, amma an mayar da su, domin mai aikawa yana da wadata mafi girma daga Allah.
Kafin ma in isa fadar mai aikowa, an kai karagar mulki ta mai girma zuwa can cikin mamaki cikin kiftawar ido.
Da na isa, sai aka tambaye ni ko gadon sarautar da aka ɗauka nawa ne, sai na amsa, 'Kamar dai shi ne wannan gadon.'
Na shiga wani babban zauren da bene na yi zaton tafkin ruwa ne, kuma a wannan lokacin na yi mamaki, na miƙa kaina tare da Annabi Sulaiman ga Allah, Ubangijin talikai.

trial.label: Babban Taron
options: Gina jirgi don tsira daga ambaliyar ruwa

location.label: Babban Abu
options: Sanda da ta rikide ta zama maciji
Jirgin ruwa da aka yi da alluna da ƙusoshi

outcome.label: Sakamakon Ƙarshe
options: Mika wuya ga Allah ɗaya tilo na gaskiya (Allah)
Gina hasumiya mai tsayi domin isa ga Allah
Rasa dukiya mai yawa a matsayin hukunci
outcome.answer: Mika wuya ga Allah ɗaya tilo na gaskiya (Allah)

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
